why_this_target: Code nobody in this project wrote, with ground truth that is not ours: three advisories in the GitHub Advisory Database, each with the upstream commit that fixed it. The audited files are the PARENT of that commit - the vulnerable state - fetched through the GitHub API.
how_ground_truth_was_obtained: gh api /advisories?ecosystem=pip&severity=high&type=reviewed, then gh api repos/Netflix/lemur/commits/<fix> for the files each fix touched, then gh api repos/.../contents/<path>?ref=<parent> for the code as it stood before it.
honest_limits: The auditors received the affected MODULES, not the whole repository, which is easier than a real engagement. Recall is measured against advisories that exist; a defect nobody has published is not counted either way. And the scoring was done by this project, reading the upstream fix - the ground truth is external, the comparison is ours.

cases.class: any authenticated user can revoke arbitrary certificates at the CA by uploading a duplicate row
unchecked replaces[] lets any user silence notifications on certificates they do not own
authenticated low-privilege users read plaintext destination credentials through the API
